map.两端开口管基频（f₁ = v / 2L） 使用指南: Open-Open Pipe Fundamental Frequency (f1 = v / 2L) User Guide
map.输入管长与声速，按 f₁=v/(2L) 计算两端开口管的基频与谐波，适用于管乐器: Enter the pipe length and speed of sound to compute the fundamental and harmonics of an open-open pipe with f1 = v/(2L), for wind instrument tuning, acoustic resonance analysis and standing wave demonstrations.
map.两端开口管的基频波长为管长 2 倍。: For a pipe open at both ends, the fundamental wavelength is twice the pipe length.
map.两端开口的管（如长笛、开管）驻波频率 f_n=n·c/(2L)，n=1,2,3…: For a pipe open at both ends (such as a flute or an open pipe), the standing wave frequencies are f_n = n*c/(2L), n = 1, 2, 3, ...
map.计算开管基频与全部整数泛音。: Compute the open-pipe fundamental and all integer harmonics.
map.管乐器调音时按长度反推频率。: For wind instrument tuning, back out the frequency from the length.
map.：管长 L=0.66 m、声速 c=343 m/s，基频 f1=c/(2L)=3: Pipe length L = 0.66 m and speed of sound c = 343 m/s give the fundamental f1 = c/(2L) = 343/1.32 = about 260 Hz; the harmonics are 2f1, 3f1, ... (integer multiples).
map.矩形房间轴向共振频率: Axial Resonance Frequencies of a Rectangular Room
map.点声源在距离 r 处的声强: Intensity of a point source at distance r
map.开管与闭管音色为何不同？: Why do open and closed pipes sound different?
map.开管含全部整数谐波、闭管仅奇次，谐波结构不同导致音色差异。: An open pipe contains all integer harmonics while a closed pipe has only odd ones; the different harmonic structure produces the tonal difference.
map.实际管口需要修正吗？: Does the actual pipe opening need an end correction?
map.真实开口端略外延（端部修正），有效长度略大于几何长度，精密计算需加上修正量。: A real open end extends slightly (end correction), so the effective length is slightly greater than the geometric length; precise calculations need the correction added.
